subject.title: feat(agents): add sessions_delegate and sessions_delegate_batch tools

question: Should OpenClaw add two new core synchronous delegation tool IDs, including built-in batch fan-out, rather than keeping orchestration on the existing spawn/yield or plugin surfaces?
rationale: This is a permanent public tool and policy expansion across session lifecycle and an RCE-sensitive gateway boundary; implementation review cannot decide whether that additional core surface is desirable.

options.title: Approve after boundary repairs
options.body: Accept the two core tools only after the four blockers are fixed and real single/batch runtime proof is supplied.

options.title: Narrow to one primitive
options.body: Expose one synchronous delegation primitive and implement batching through model parallel calls or a higher-level orchestration layer.

options.title: Keep orchestration external
options.body: Decline new core tool IDs and leave richer fan-out/fan-in patterns to plugins or workflows built on existing session primitives.

recommendation.title: Approve after boundary repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the two core tools only after the four blockers are fixed and real single/batch runtime proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history owns the current depth-aware session tool-policy boundary most directly affected by this product choice.
